mapper.select: SELECT id, role_name, description, create_time, update_time FROM roles ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.description, r.create_time, r.update_time FROM roles r INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO roles (role_name, description, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{roleName}, #{description}, NOW(), NOW())
